title: Name Signs for the Animals

readiness.reading: hearing the sounds in short words; matching sounds to letters (moveable alphabet)

concepts: hearing each sound in a word

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Here are little wooden boards, and a box of letters. Let's make a name sign for some of the animals.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Tap the picture to hear its name. Tap a letter to hear its sound.

older.prompt: Listen to the name. Which sounds do you hear, first to last? Find each letter in the box.

steps.prompt: Listen to the name. Which sounds do you hear? Put each letter in its place.

feedback.wrong: Listen again: {word}. That sound goes somewhere else.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Now everyone will know whose home is whose. The signs are up!

journal_line: I made name signs for the animals, listening for each sound and finding its letter.
unavailable_text: The animals already have their name signs.
